scientific.integrity: The theorem is obtained by exact substitution into the first practical MADGRAD update. The diagonal quadratic makes the objective change coordinate-separable, yielding a necessary-and-sufficient stability frontier and exact spike radius.
limitations: Only the first practical update is classified.
The exact multidimensional frontier assumes an axis-aligned SPD quadratic.
No stochastic gradients or weight decay are included.
The convergence-theory variant with the additional gradient-bound denominator term is outside the stated formula.

title: Epsilon sets a sharp first-step stability frontier in practical MADGRAD
